text: Coffee with Mila after work. She's got a second interview at the architecture firm next Tuesday and is a bag of nerves about the portfolio bit. Her flatmate Ioana is helping her rehearse. Text Mila good luck Monday night. Also she mentioned her mum's been unwell, keeps getting dizzy spells, and has a scan booked for sometime next week, so ask about that too when things calm down.

Wiremu's new puppy is a collie cross called Tama, ten weeks old and already chewing skirting boards. He's doing puppy classes Saturday mornings. His partner Shira wanted a cat, so that's a sore point. Shira's also job hunting, two applications in for marketing roles in town, hoping to hear by the end of the month. Remind me to forward her that Bristol vacancy.

Long chat with Dimitri on the phone. Applied for the head groundsman job at the cricket club, hears back end of the month. Still obsessed with Olympiacos, watches every match at 3am. His dad's 70th is early March, family do in Thessaloniki.
Manon's cat Biscuit has kidney trouble, vet says it's managing it now rather than fixing it. She's taking it hard. Check in with her later this week.

Bogdan and Vanessa came round for dinner. They're off to Lisbon over the summer for their tenth anniversary. Bogdan's started building model trains again, whole loft is a layout. Vanessa rolls her eyes but secretly loves it.

Khadija didn't get the NHS admin job, found out yesterday. She's fine about it, says the commute would've killed her. Applying for a school office role instead, closing date Friday. I said I'd read her personal statement tomorrow. Her husband Amir thinks she should hold out for something better paid but she just wants school hours for the kids. Her eldest has a swimming gala this weekend too.
Ran into Amir at the climbing wall. He's training for a bouldering comp in a fortnight, first one ever. Mentioned his sister Olivia just moved to Leeds for uni. Nice lad.
Abigail rang. Her interview with the council got cancelled, they've frozen hiring. She's gutted. Need to send her that list of recruiters.
Agnieszka knits for the whole street apparently. Her granddaughter Jess turns six next Thursday and she's making a unicorn jumper. Jess is into anything purple at the moment.
Lola's dog Pepper had her first birthday Sunday, Lola threw a pup party in the park with a dog-safe cake. Six dogs, total chaos. She's thinking of getting a second one in the new year.

Delroy finally heard back from Rolls-Royce. Final round is Wednesday at the Derby site, panel of three. He's prepped to death but still not sleeping. His wife Eilidh says he's unbearable. Wish him luck Tuesday evening and ask how it went after.
Pick up dog food and flea stuff on the way home Thursday.
Efua's into pottery now, Wednesday night classes at the community centre. Made me a wonky mug which I love. She'd really like her own wheel eventually, worth remembering for Christmas.

Caught up with Eva and Bilal at the pub quiz. Bilal's started a new job at a games studio in Dundee, first week went well, they've given him a level to design already. Eva is staying down here until the end of the year then joining him. Their rabbit Clover is going with Eva for now. Eva admitted she's not looking forward to the long distance bit and is a bit low about it. I'm going up to visit them both in spring.
Imani's cat went missing Tuesday night. Posted on the local group, nothing yet. Call her tomorrow to see if there's news.
Yetunde sent a voice note. Her son Aidan got into the county under 14s football squad, trials were last weekend. She's beside herself. Must congratulate him properly when I see them on Sunday.
Hoang is learning Vietnamese calligraphy from his grandad. Showed me photos, honestly gorgeous. His grandad's turning ninety sometime next month.

Alfie's applied for twelve apprenticeships and heard nothing from any. His mum is worried he's losing heart. He's mad on Spurs and FIFA, if I want to cheer him up. Ask Kieran if his place takes apprentices.
Lorenzo got the job! Starts at the bakery chain head office on the 3rd of November. Bring a bottle round this weekend.
Aidan's mum had her hip done on Monday, home now and grumpy. He's doing the school runs for his sister Mai's kids until half term. Pop a card through his mum's door sometime next week.
Ayesha's band has a gig at the Brudenell on Friday the 14th, first proper headline slot. She plays bass. Already bought tickets for me and Zainab.
Zainab hates birthday fuss, she said so twice. Keep it low key.
Quick one. Dr Kim at the practice says the cat's teeth need doing, booked for next Wednesday. Starve her from 8pm the night before.
Mila got the job at the architecture firm, starts January. Ioana's throwing her a little party next Saturday. Get Mila something for the new desk, she mentioned wanting a proper drafting lamp.
Wiremu says Tama passed puppy class and now sits on command, mostly. Shira has come round to him. They're thinking of a dog-friendly cottage in Wales over Easter.

Phoned Uncle Delroy for a natter. He's taken up bowls at the club, plays Tuesdays and Thursdays, and he's in the doubles final this weekend with his mate from church. Bad knee playing up again though, and Auntie Efua is nagging him to see someone. He keeps saying he'll get it looked at after the season. Ask him how the final went on Monday.
Dimitri heard back early, didn't get the groundsman job. Bit flat but philosophical. Says he'll go for the assistant role at the rugby club instead, interview sometime next week.
Need to renew the car insurance before the end of the month and book an MOT. Also the gym membership thing.

Manon messaged, Biscuit had a good week and is eating again. Her brother Alfie is staying with her for a few days. She sounded much brighter. Alfie's in town for a job interview at the uni on Thursday, research assistant post, so she's dragging him to the Pompidou exhibition afterwards. She asked if I still want the spare knitting yarn, which I do.

Bogdan told me Vanessa's mum has been in hospital since Saturday with pneumonia. Vanessa is going back and forth every evening and is shattered. He's doing all the cooking. Drop a meal round to them tomorrow night and text Vanessa.
Khadija got an interview for the school office job, Thursday 2pm. She's weirdly calm. Her daughter Lola starts reception at the same school, which is a nice bonus.
Amir came third at the bouldering comp! He's chuffed. Says next up is a regional one early March in Sheffield.

Met Abigail's new boyfriend Lorenzo at her birthday drinks. Seems nice, works in IT, supports Celtic which Abigail finds unforgivable. She's been applying for jobs in Glasgow, which might explain things.
Agnieszka's husband passed away three years ago today, she mentioned it quietly. She's doing OK, keeps busy with knitting and the allotment.
Lola is starting a new job at the vets on Monday, reception and some nursing. She's nervous about the early shifts. Pepper gets to come in on Fridays.

Eilidh rang about Delroy. He got the Rolls-Royce job, starts in January, relocating to Derby in the spring. She's thrilled but nervous about leaving her book club and her mum. They're throwing a garden party next Saturday to celebrate, I'm bringing the dessert. Need to get Delroy a card and maybe a nice pen.
Efua's pottery teacher has entered one of her bowls in a local craft show end of next month. She's so proud. Go and see it.

Bilal says the Dundee studio is putting him forward for a promotion review in early December. Eva is flying up this weekend for the first time since he moved. Clover the rabbit is staying with me while she's away, Friday to Monday.
Imani found the cat! He was locked in a neighbour's shed for three days. Thin but fine. She's buying him a GPS collar.

Yetunde's husband Delroy is applying for jobs abroad, Canada mainly. She's not keen at all, they argued about it over the weekend. Keep an ear out. Their daughter's GCSEs are this summer which makes timing awful.
Hoang's job interview at the bank went badly, he thinks, they asked loads of technical stuff he hadn't prepped. Results by Friday. Text him Friday afternoon either way.

Alfie got an interview! Electrician apprenticeship, next Monday morning. His mum says he's terrified, keeps practising in the mirror. Kieran said he'll give him a lift. If he gets it he'd start in September at the college two days a week. He's also been doing up an old moped with his grandad on weekends, which apparently is all he talks about. Message Alfie Sunday night with good luck.
Lorenzo's first day went fine but he hates the open plan. He's taken up sourdough at home as revenge. His girlfriend Mai is very much enjoying the bread.
Note to self: knitting group is moving to Mondays from next week.
Aidan says his mum is walking with a frame already. Physio twice a week. He looks tired though. He plays five-a-side Wednesdays and hasn't been in ages.
Ayesha's gig was rammed, they sold out of t-shirts. A label person was there apparently. She's meeting them sometime next week.

Zainab's interview for the charity comms role is Tuesday at 11. She really wants this one, been out of work since June. Her cat Moose has been her emotional support through the whole thing. Ring her Tuesday afternoon.
Shira mentioned she's training for the Edinburgh half in May, running with her sister Eilidh. Long runs on Sundays. She's vegan now too.
Hosting Jess's birthday tea on Saturday, Agnieszka's bringing the unicorn cake. Twelve kids. God help me.
Kieran Hughes from the five-a-side, Kez to everyone, is applying for a teaching course starting September. Needs a reference by the end of the month. Remind me to write it this weekend.

Olivia (Amir's sister) is struggling at uni, homesick and behind on essays. Amir's driving up to Leeds next weekend to see her. He asked if I'd send her a care package, she likes Haribo and true crime books.

Talked to Mai about her kids. Her eldest, Mila, has a piano exam on the 22nd, grade four, and is practising every night. Her youngest just got a hamster called Noodle. Mai herself is going for a team leader role at work, interview in a fortnight. She says she'll believe it when it happens.
Vanessa's mum is home from hospital, much better. Vanessa says thanks for the lasagne. Lisbon trip still on for August.
Bogdan's model train club has a show at the town hall the first weekend in December. He's built a whole Carpathian mountain scene. Said I'd go along with the kids.
Wiremu's birthday is next Friday. He keeps hinting about a new rugby shirt, the All Blacks home one. Shira says he's an L. Get it ordered by Tuesday.

Phone call with Dimitri. Rugby club interview is Thursday. Then his dad's 70th in early March, and Olympiacos away at Arsenal end of November which he has tickets for. He's flying out Wednesday after next for a cousin's wedding too. Busy man.
Eva says the long distance is going better now. Lots of FaceTime, quiz nights online. Clover is fat and happy.
Manon's thinking about applying for a curator job at the gallery in Bath. Deadline isn't till end of January. Send her my old cover letter as a template.

Imani's fostering a litter of kittens for the RSPCA now, five of them, eight weeks old. Her partner Efua is pretending not to be attached. They go to new homes over the next few weeks. One is definitely staying, I reckon.
Ayesha's band played a wedding on Saturday instead of the festival, which got called off because of flooding. Paid better anyway. Next practice is Thursday.
